review_candidates.description: Technica Corporation is seeking highly skilled Infrastructure Operations Engineer who is responsible for maintaining, supporting, and improving enterprise collaboration, reporting, and authentication platforms across the organization. This role ensures stability, security, and performance of critical systems including SharePoint, Power BI Report Server, SQL clusters, and various on premises and cloud-based infrastructure services. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical troubleshooting skills, a solid understanding of hybrid environments, and the ability to support security/ATO compliance efforts. Key Responsibilities SharePoint Administration Manage, configure, and maintain on premises, Azure and cloud-based SharePoint environments. Perform troubleshooting, monitoring, and performance optimization. Support governance and service requests. Administer SharePoint Online (SPO), including security, access controls, and feature management. Power BI Report Server Administration Administer and maintain on prem/Azure Power BI Report Server. Configure data sources, manage report deployment, and support users with report accessibility issues. Monitor server performance and ensure report refresh reliability. Monitor and support SQL server for Power BI RS Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS) Support ADFS environments, including troubleshooting authentication/claims issues. Maintain configurations supporting secure access to enterprise applications. SQL & Failover Cluster Support Possess baseline SQL administration knowledge. Support SQL cluster monitoring, failover testing, and basic troubleshooting. Collaborate with database teams on maintenance, patches, and stability improvements. Server Administration Perform Windows Server maintenance, including patching, updates, and configuration management. Azure Administration (or Familiarity with Azure Backend) Manage or support Azure services related to identity, storage, SharePoint Online, and hybrid integrations. General Infrastructure Operations Respond to escalated operational tickets and resolve issues promptly. Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. Participate in system upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure enhancement projects. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across security, networking, development, and data platforms. The government has established policies for on-site vs hybrid work which varies across divisions and contracts. Where allowed, remote work must be coordinated with the team lead and/or government POC, ensuring there is zero interruption with the delivery of our services. Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to manage multiple priorities. We specialize in a wide range of advanced information technology solutions from Systems Engineering to Cyber Security, and from Software Development to Product Solutions. From our locations across the DC Metro area, Hampton, Virginia, and Huntsville, Alabama, we provide technological subject matter expertise, program management and business process knowledge as a trusted advisor in support of our Department of Defense and other Federal Agency customers. review_candidates.description: Company Description Join us and make YOUR mark on the World! Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability. Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact. Job Description We have an opening for an Enterprise Secure Network (ESN) Associate Program Leader (APL) - Platform and Infrastructure . You will provide strategic and operational leadership to advance ESN and ESN Hub modernization for the infrastructure organization that enables reliable, secure, scalable, and modern enterprise services across ESN. The Associate Program Leader will lead a broad portfolio of technical workstreams and serve as a trusted partner in shaping the future of the ESN infrastructure. This position is in the Enterprise Infrastructure Services (EIS) Division, within the Computing Directorate, in support of ESN. This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You will have the flexibility to work from home up to one day per week. You will Lead strategic direction for ESN modernization by partnering with ESN leadership and architecture teams to define and champion long-term cloud, server, and network strategies that enable program growth and mission success. Provide leadership oversight of the ESN Platform and Infrastructure portfolio by building strategic relationships with program and enterprise leadership as well as NNSA stakeholders to drive interoperability across ESN and adjacent programs. Direct infrastructure operations through delegation and team empowerment, ensuring maximum uptime and efficiency while developing leadership capabilities across program and technical teams. Drive organizational transformation for infrastructure modernization and operational excellence by establishing strategic priorities, aligning cross-functional resources, optimizing team structures, and ensuring accountability for execution across multiple technical teams. Serve as the strategic visionary for ESN infrastructure evolution, collaborating with executive leadership and stakeholders to shape the delivery of resilient, secure, and efficient services. Oversee strategic planning for budgets, workforce development, and supply chain strategies that support infrastructure operations and lifecycle management. Lead vendor and stakeholder relationships by leveraging procurement expertise to guide contract negotiations, establish performance frameworks including SLAs, and ensure effective service provider management. Champion governance frameworks and ensure organizational alignment with IT policies and cybersecurity protocols. Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications This position requires an active Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance or active Top-Secret clearance issued by another U.S. government agency at the time of hire. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of technical training and experience. Expert experience leading large, diverse technical organizations in the delivery of mission critical enterprise IT infrastructure with minimal direction in a complex enterprise environment. Expert experience mentoring technical teams on modern VDI architectures, such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, or AVD, hybrid cloud integration patterns, and enterprise-scale network designs that support large user environments, including SD-WAN, QoS policies, protocol optimization, and multi-datacenter load balancing. Subject-matter expertise in enterprise IT vendor management and strategic vendor partnerships, including Microsoft EA/AWS EDP negotiations, licensing optimization across subscription, consumption-based, and perpetual models, RFP/RFQ processes for infrastructure and software platforms, SLA-driven contract negotiations, FinOps and cloud cost governance, and evaluation of emerging technology providers such as Microsoft, AWS, VMware, Cisco, and Oracle. Expert strategic leadership experience translating vision into enterprise modernization programs, including cloud migrations, datacenter consolidation, application rationalization, mission-critical infrastructure upgrades, DevSecOps transformation, and BCDR architecture for tier-1 applications. Expert experience building technology roadmaps, securing executive sponsorship, and delivering large-scale initiatives with measurable business or mission impact while maintaining operational continuity is preferred. Expert communication and collaborative leadership, building trust across infrastructure, application, security, and operations teams while engaging executive stakeholders and C-suite executives (CIO, CISO, CFO) through transparent communication and technical credibility. Expert experience leading enterprise infrastructure transformation, including data center modernization, such as hyperconverged infrastructure, VMware vSAN, and Nutanix, network evolution, hybrid cloud architecture using technologies such as VMware Cloud Foundation, Azure Stack HCI, and AWS Outposts, and storage upgrades including flash arrays and NVMe. Qualifications We Desire Experienced infrastructure leader with deep technical credibility, strong people leadership, and a clear vision for evolving ESN to meet future mission requirements. Effective in both day-to-day operational leadership and long-term strategy for platform and infrastructure services. Pay Range $227,430 - $288,396 Annually This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. Additional Information Position Information This is a Career Indefinite position, open to Lab employees and external candidates. Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory? Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor! Flexible Benefits Package 401(k) Relocation Assistance Education Reimbursement Program Flexible schedules (*depending on project needs) Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values Security Clearance This position requires an active Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance or active Top Secret clearance issued by another U.S. government agency at time of hire. Pre-Employment Drug Test External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor. Wireless and Medical Devices Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices. If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. To learn more about recruitment scams: https://www.llnl.gov/sites/www/files/2023-05/LLNL-Job-Fraud-Statement-Updated-4.26.23.pdf Equal Employment Opportunity We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request. California Privacy Notice The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. You'll go beyond the phone call to work the network layer voice depends on routing and switching, firewalls, QoS, DNS/DHCP, and packet-level diagnostics, isolating issues and proving root cause with real evidence. The role blends remote support with on-site visits, including travel to customer locations for assessing and deploying managed network solutions, giving you the chance to deepen your expertise across telephony, networking, and managed services while sharpening your customer service skills. If you're ready to take your networking know-how to the next level, we'd love to hear from you, apply today. Duties And Responsibilities Provide advanced remote and on-site support for VoIP systems, network infrastructure, and desktop applications via phone, email, and chat. Diagnose and resolve network-layer issues affecting voice quality (QoS/traffic prioritization, jitter, latency, packet loss, DNS/DHCP, VLANs, NAT, SIP ALG); troubleshoot and configure firewalls, routers, switches, and managed network gear. Use packet capture and diagnostic tools (Wireshark, VoIPmonitor, PingPlotter, syslogs) to isolate root cause and document findings before applying a fix. Assess customer network environments and assist in positioning and deploying managed network solutions such as Peplink and UniFi. Resolve issues escalated from Level I Support and Field Technicians, including hardware and software diagnostics; escalate unresolved cases to the appropriate support level. Assess, prioritize, and monitor tickets of moderate complexity, owning each through resolution in line with KPI and SLA standards. Administer and program VoIP phone systems and network configurations. Perform structured cabling work as needed — installation, tracing, testing, and terminating CAT 5E/6/6E and coaxial cable. Participate in design and planning meetings for telephone and data systems with Engineering, end users, and external partners to gather requirements and meet project timelines. Handle a broad range of support requests, including network troubleshooting/configuration, phone system programming, hardware/software diagnostics, mobile app assistance, basic Windows support, password resets, and referrals to sales for upsell opportunities. Manage clients in CRM/service software and maintain logs, time records, and documentation of hardware, networks, and equipment. Participate in training, mentorship, and cross-training to build team expertise, and contribute to internal knowledge base articles on repair, installation, and troubleshooting best practices. Communicate proactively with leadership and clients on emerging issues, trends, and opportunities to improve support operations; complete required performance self-assessments. Coordinate with clients to schedule troubleshooting sessions; perform additional duties as assigned by leadership. Other duties as assigned by leadership Requirements QUALIFICATIONS Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing/switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, QoS) with hands-on firewall and edge-device troubleshooting experience. Comfort reading and interpreting packet captures and network diagnostics, with the discipline to capture evidence before applying a fix. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the capacity to acquire new skills quickly. Experience with CRM, reporting, and ticketing systems (Salesforce, Zoho, etc.), including building targeted reports and analytics on an ad hoc basis. Excellent verbal and written communication, organizational, time management, and interpersonal skills. Highly motivated self-starter able to lead initiatives and collaborate within a team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Must be willing to commute and work in the Charlotte area; must be 21 years of age with a valid driver’s license and clean driving record. Education And Experience Associate’s or bachelor’s degree or certification in IT, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with demonstrated network support/administration experience (routers, switches, firewalls). CompTIA Network+ required (Level II qualifying certification); Security+, Fortinet (FCA/FCP), Netgate pfSense+, or Peplink certifications preferred. Telecom industry experience preferred, particularly IP telephony, networking, and desktop support; familiarity with VoIP technologies (SIP, RTP, codecs, Avaya IP Office, 3CX) and managed network/SD-WAN platforms (Peplink InControl, UniFi) preferred. Experience with paging systems and related hardware; proficient in cabling installation, tracing, testing, and terminating CAT 5E/6/6E and coaxial cable; understanding of analog telephony (Tip and Ring) troubleshooting. Previous customer service experience required. Completion of required Field Support Training and Support Technician Level II qualifying training/certification (CompTIA Network+, NS LMS Admin, 3CX Advanced, MS700), or equivalent experience. Physical Experience Prolonged periods of sitting or standing at a desk and working on computers. Must be able to lift 50 pounds at times. May be required to work on-call or long hours in the event of a network malfunction. This is not a remote position and may require travel to and from customer sites. #ZR

review_candidates.title: Manager Cyber Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: Giới thiệu chung Nhóm Cyber Security Engineer là một trong các nhóm chuyên trách thuộc Phòng An ninh Thông tin, chịu trách nhiệm nghiên cứu, thiết kế, triển khai và vận hành các giải pháp, kiểm soát an ninh thông tin cho toàn bộ hạ tầng, hệ thống và ứng dụng của công ty – bao gồm hạ tầng cloud (GCP, AWS), on-premise và các dịch vụ liên quan. Nhóm phối hợp chặt chẽ với các bộ phận SOC (Security Operations Center), Product Security và GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) để đảm bảo một hệ sinh thái an ninh thông tin toàn diện, nhất quán và tuân thủ. Lead Cyber Security Engineer là người dẫn dắt kỹ thuật (technical lead) của nhóm, chịu trách nhiệm về kiến trúc an ninh thông tin (security architecture), định hướng công nghệ, chất lượng triển khai các giải pháp bảo mật, đồng thời mentor và phát triển năng lực cho các thành viên trong nhóm. Trách nhiệm chính Kiến trúc & định hướng kỹ thuật Thiết kế, xây dựng và chuẩn hóa security architecture cho hạ tầng cloud (GCP, AWS) và on-premise, đảm bảo các nguyên tắc defense-in-depth, zero trust, least privilege. Xây dựng security reference architecture, security baseline, design pattern cho các hệ thống, dự án mới trước khi go-live. Đánh giá, lựa chọn và định hướng công nghệ/giải pháp an ninh thông tin phù hợp với chiến lược phát triển của công ty (WAF, DLP, CASB, CSPM, CWPP, IAM/PAM, Secrets Management…). Tham gia review kiến trúc hệ thống, dự án mới (architecture review board) với vai trò đại diện an ninh thông tin. Triển khai & vận hành giải pháp bảo mật Dẫn dắt việc triển khai, cấu hình, tối ưu các giải pháp/kiểm soát an ninh thông tin cho hạ tầng cloud và ứng dụng: network security, identity & access management, data protection, workload protection, logging & monitoring... Đảm bảo các giải pháp bảo mật được vận hành ổn định, có SLA rõ ràng, có quy trình vận hành chuẩn (runbook, SOP). Chủ trì việc rà soát, đánh giá cấu hình an ninh (security configuration review, hardening) định kỳ cho hệ thống cloud và hạ tầng trọng yếu. Quản lý rủi ro & phối hợp liên phòng ban Phối hợp với SOC trong việc xây dựng use-case phát hiện, phản ứng sự cố (detection & response) dựa trên kiến trúc và giải pháp đã triển khai. Phối hợp với Product Security để đảm bảo các kiểm soát bảo mật hạ tầng và ứng dụng nhất quán, không có khoảng trống (security gap). Phối hợp với GRC để đảm bảo các giải pháp/kiểm soát triển khai đáp ứng yêu cầu tuân thủ (ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2, quy định pháp luật liên quan...). Tham gia đánh giá rủi ro an ninh thông tin cho các dự án, đối tác, nhà cung cấp mới (third-party/vendor risk). Quản lý đội nhóm Lead, phân công, giám sát tiến độ công việc của các Security Engineer trong nhóm. Coaching, mentor kỹ thuật, xây dựng lộ trình phát triển năng lực cho thành viên. Xây dựng và cải tiến quy trình làm việc, tài liệu kỹ thuật, tiêu chuẩn triển khai của nhóm. Tham gia tuyển dụng, đánh giá năng lực ứng viên/thành viên trong nhóm. Nghiên cứu & cải tiến Cập nhật xu hướng công nghệ, mối đe dọa mới (threat landscape), kỹ thuật tấn công mới liên quan đến cloud và hạ tầng.
